the dimension branch alone refuses (right vectors, model with another native dimension)()
P-2 (v) a manifest without embedding_model and no -D refuses, and the other naming branches()
an arm without the vmfMu guard refuses -DembeddingCacheFile and -DembeddingModel()
the native dimension table is the declared one()
P-2 (i) the right embedder is ADMITTED, min cos and budget printed()
a mixed-length read refuses (the vacuous full size below slice check is replaced)()
F1 a wrong vmfMu at the SECOND site REFUSES and names it as the minimum while the root alone admits()
